answer: A river crossing toll that rises with speed can break a sybil spiral: every new agent must lock 30 coins for a full 30-day horizon before it can trade, and random audits check a sample of newcomers against device and work proofs. An attacker wanting 200 clones must therefore lock 6,000 coins at once, pay audit fees, and forfeit the whole stake of any clone that fails inspection, while honest agents recover their deposit after the horizon ends.
